items.name: Icelandic Nationals 2018

venue.name: [Háskólinn Reykjavík / Reykjavik university](https://en.ru.is/)
venue.details: Room M201 (Follow the signs) / Stofa M201 (Fylgið merkingunum)

items.information:
**Walk in registrations will be allowed for Sunday events only**

This competition is also recognized as "Iceland Championships". Icelandic citizens will be rewarded and will get "Iceland champion titles". 
Space in the venue is limited, please let us know how many people will come with you.
It will be possible to order T-shirts. Contact us if you have any questions!
You will have to pay the registration fees at the venue the day of the competition to participate: kr500 (~4€~4.5USD)
________

Þetta mót er einnig skráð sem "Íslandsmót" þar sem fljótustu Íslendingarnir munu fá verðlaun og verða þeir krýndir Íslandsmeistarar.
Pláss á staðnum er takmarkað svo endilega látið okkur vita hversu marga gesti þið munuð hafa með ykkur.
Mögulegt verður að panta stuttermaboli. Sendið spurningar á okkur ef eitthvað er óljóst!
Mótsgjald er 500 krónur fyrir keppendur og verður það greitt á mótsdag.
________
.

items.name: Venice of the East Open 2018
items.information:
There is no on-spot registration.
Participation limit is 50, so register as soon as possible.
Registration closes either on June 8, 2018, 11:59 p.m. IST or when registration count reaches 50 (whichever comes first)
[Click here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VeniceoftheEastOpen2018/register) to register.

items.name: Jaktim Mini Fasting 2018

venue.name: Pusat Grosir Cililitan (PGC)
venue.address: Jl. Mayjen Sutoyo No. 76 Cililitan Jakarta Timur

items.information:
Kompetisi official pertama yang diselenggarakan oleh Komunitas Rubik Jakarta Timur. Maximum kompetitor pada kompetisi ini adalah 100 orang. Kami menerapkan sistem siapa cepat, dia dapat (siapa yang membayar terlebih dahulu).
Setiap peserta akan mendapatkan takjil (snack) dan air putih untuk berbuka puasa.

_____________________

This is the first official competition that held by the Jakarta Timur Rubik Community. The maximum competitors for this competition are 100 people. We will use the first 'come', first serve basis (who pays first).
Every participants will get a free snack & water for breaking the fast.

venue.name: Preparatoria Ibero Puebla
venue.address: Preparatoria Ibero Puebla Blvrd del Niño Poblano 2901 Reserva Territorial Atlixcáyotl, Centro Comercial Puebla 72430 Pue

items.information:
Primera competencia en México con todas las categorias "silenciosas" Todas las categorías  *BLINDFOLD* y 3 intentos de *FMC*.

*Fase 1: $150.00 (15 de Mayo último día)
Fase 2: $200.00 (30 de Mayo, último día)*

**IMPORTANTE**
Lleva una identificación con fotografía el día de la competencia (de lo contrario no podrás acceder a la sede)
También tus acompañantes deberán llevar una identificación para su acceso. 
Bajo ninguna circunstancia habrá inscripciones una vez que el límite sea haya cubierto. 
Si hiciste el depósito y no alcanzaste lugar, favor de mandar correo electrónico después del día del evento para poder regresar tu cooperación (Fecha Límite, 30 de Junio) al correo: KeepYourCalmMexico@gmail.com
 
**Límite de competidores :  80  **

Costo de recuperación: $150
